title: Generate and validate a 2D sprite animation
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for generate and validate a 2d sprite animation.

ordered_stages.action: Lock canvas, palette, silhouette, pivot, baseline, directions, and frame timing.
Generate candidates with seed, model, prompt, and reference provenance.
Normalize transparency, bounds, alignment, palette, and frame dimensions.
Assemble the loop and inspect temporal continuity at target speed.
Import a copy into the target engine and capture runtime evidence.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Alpha edges are clean and every frame shares a stable baseline.
Loop endpoints, timing, proportions, and identity remain consistent.

fallbacks: Repair frames deterministically in Aseprite or Pixelorama.
Retain approved frames and regenerate only failing poses.
